scope: Offline preparation; observed candidates and synthetic demo kept separate

summary.limitations: Q1 MC uses 10,000 Student-t copula scenarios from 365 daily market returns (max 1-day ETH drop -14.34%, depeg -0.56%), complemented by 19 post-execution tail stress scenarios (-10% to -50% ETH, -1% to -10% depeg). Q3 bounded execution holds oracle prices fixed after initial shock (no endogenous DEX->oracle feedback). Compound III Q3 evaluates Comet price-only eligibility and explicit base-supply withdrawals without inventing collateral absorption.
